title: Jude and the Archive
author: F. M. Dunmore
blurb: August Quintana, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the fleet's truce expires.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
